title: fix(platform-objects): retranslate the view navigation help in seven locales
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbGyo1s5XDjcEx7u8WDqbFTx)_

Fixes #35915

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用阿拉伯语、德语、法语、韩语、巴西葡语、俄语、繁体中文的管理员，在视图表单「导航」与「导航模式」的说明里，不再看到「默认用抽屉打开」，改为与英文一致的新说法。
- 属于列表打开记录方式调整（视图导航模式废弃）的收尾，替这七种语言的管理员补齐译文。
- 只改说明文字，出错只是某句译文不通顺，不影响任何功能，可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{ar,de,fr,ko,pt-BR,ru,zh-Hant}.metadata-forms.generated.ts`: two leaf values each, `metadataForms.view.fields.navigation.helpText` (line 1358) and `"navigation.mode".helpText` (line 1362), re-translated from the current English source, following the zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES renderings. Code tokens (`drawer`, `page`, `new_window`, `none`, `preventNavigation: true`, `listViews`, `navigation`, `mode`) are kept as written; the deprecation marker uses each locale's existing spelling (`[VERALTET]`, `[OBSOLÈTE]`, `[OBSOLETO]`, `[УСТАРЕЛО]`, `[사용 중단]`, `[مُهمَل]`, `[已棄用]`).
- `{same seven}.source-hashes.generated.ts`: `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=platform-objects --write` dropped the one row `metadataForms.view.fields.navigation.mode.helpText` from each. That row recorded the leaf as a byte copy of an older English source; it is now a real translation, so the extractor drops the entry itself (no hand edit).
- `.changeset/35915-navigation-help-seven-locales.md`: `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch (the bundles ship in that package).

## Why

The view `navigation.mode` was deprecated under #35854 (ruling: the record name opens the full page, the hover icon the side panel; `none` still means rows open nothing). The English source and zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES were rewritten then; these seven locales still said the drawer is the default, and `navigation.mode` served an older English copy.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/apps/translations` at 7fefd744: Test Files 26 passed (26), Tests 610 passed (610).
- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=platform-objects` at 7fefd744: EXIT=0, `platform-objects in sync (32 bundle(s))`.
- No ablation: text-only change, no tested behaviour moved.

## Acceptance notes

- `grep` for the old phrasings (e.g. zh-Hant 「預設為抽屜」, de `standardmäßig Seitenleiste`) in the seven files: 0 hits. The new `navigation` help still names the drawer, as its size ("drawer size"), like the English.
- German and Brazilian Portuguese use one word for both the drawer and the side panel (Seitenleiste / painel lateral), matching the existing drawer-width help in those files and the es-ES rendering.

## Verification

Read first: `zh-Hant.metadata-forms.generated.ts` lines 1358 and 1362 (compare with `zh-CN` at the same lines).

Two-minute check: `git grep -n '預設為抽屜\|tiroir par défaut\|standardmäßig Seitenleiste' -- packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations` prints nothing.
